design: Prospective42 quartets: seven fixed noun pairs, two syntax families, connective-only shift, distractor-lexeme-only shift, and both. PP with→alongside; RC that→whom; guard→officer. Complete number factorial, all12 directed swaps. Fixed relay preMLP4 near -3. No outcome-selected replacements.
competence_gate: Per condition >=4 valid quartets, >=75% quartets all-four binary correct, >=50% intended full-vocabulary top1. Keep every valid condition including failures.
frozen_prediction_plan: Average all seven saved H959 lexical-fold encoders for each feature/seed. Mean H960 lexical template full/additive state prototypes mapped by predeclared syntax family; wrong-family full prototype control; original top8. No new fitting, no new teacher information in predictions.
scope: New complete prompts relative to H954, shared subject nouns deliberately control lexical variation. Context shift only, not a new-noun transfer test. Reserved test untouched.
direction: Recipient/donor are factorial-state indices; signed historical replay is a convention, not necessarily a desired answer change.
